Question 1
?

The cubic polynomial P(x) has roots x1=−3, x2=−2, and x3=3, and the coefficient of the cubic term is 4. Find P(x).

a
4x3+8x2−9x−18
b
4x3+8x2−36x−72
c
4x3−4x2+18x−72
d
4x3+8x2−36x−18
e
4x3+4x2−18x−36

after.name: Question 1
after.problem: The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-3,$ ${x}_{2}=-2,$ and ${x}_{3}=3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $4.$ Find $P(x).$
after.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=-3,$ ${x}_{1}=-2,$ and ${x}_{3}=3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=4,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =4(x-(-3))(x-(-2))(x-3) \\  & =4(x+3)(x+2)(x-3)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}4(x+3)(x+2)(x-3) & =4({x}^{2}+5x+6)(x-3) \\  & =4({x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+5{x}^{2}-15x+6x-18) \\  & =4({x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}-9x-18) \\  & =4{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}-36x-72.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=4{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}-36x-72.$

Question 1

The cubic polynomial P(x) has roots x1=−3, x2=−2, and x3=3, and the coefficient of the cubic term is 4. Find P(x).

a
4x3+8x2−9x−18
b
4x3+8x2−36x−72
c
4x3−4x2+18x−72
d
4x3+8x2−36x−18
e
4x3+4x2−18x−36
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Since our cubic polynomial has roots x1=−3, x1=−2, and x3=3, and the coefficient of the cubic term is a=4, we can write the polynomial as follows:

a(x−x1)(x−x2)(x−x3)=4(x−(−3))(x−(−2))(x−3)=4(x+3)(x+2)(x−3)

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

4(x+3)(x+2)(x−3)=4(x2+5x+6)(x−3)=4(x3−3x2+5x2−15x+6x−18)=4(x3+2x2−9x−18)=4x3+8x2−36x−72.

Therefore, P(x)=4x3+8x2−36x−72.

content.knowledge_point: Finding a Cubic Polynomial Given Three Real Roots and a Leading Coefficient
content.problem: The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-3,$ ${x}_{2}=-2,$ and ${x}_{3}=3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $4.$ Find $P(x).$
content.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=-3,$ ${x}_{1}=-2,$ and ${x}_{3}=3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=4,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =4(x-(-3))(x-(-2))(x-3) \\  & =4(x+3)(x+2)(x-3)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}4(x+3)(x+2)(x-3) & =4({x}^{2}+5x+6)(x-3) \\  & =4({x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+5{x}^{2}-15x+6x-18) \\  & =4({x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}-9x-18) \\  & =4{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}-36x-72.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=4{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}-36x-72.$

The cubic polynomial $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-5,{x}_{2,3}=\pm 2\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $5.$ Find $f(x).$

$f(x)=$

{{field-2}}${x}^{2}\,+$

{{field-4}}
content.worked_solution:
Since $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-5$ and ${x}_{2,3}=\pm 2\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=5,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =5(x-(-5))(x-2\text{i})(x-(-2\text{i})) \\  & =5(x+5)(x-2\text{i})(x+2\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}5(x+5)(x-2\text{i})(x+2\text{i}) & = \\ 5(x+5)({x}^{2}-(2\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ 5(x+5)({x}^{2}+4) & = \\ 5({x}^{3}+5{x}^{2}+4x+20) & = \\ 5{x}^{3}+25{x}^{2}+20x+100 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=5{x}^{3}+25{x}^{2}+20x+100.$

$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-7(x-1)(x-4\text{i})(x+4\text{i}) & = \\ -7(x-1)({x}^{2}+x(4\text{i})-x(4\text{i})-(4\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ -7(x-1)({x}^{2}+16) & = \\ -7({x}^{3}+16x-{x}^{2}-16) & = \\ -7{x}^{3}+7{x}^{2}-112x+112.\end{aligned}
